title: THE LAST TEXT
style: cinematic film still, moody dark thriller, dramatic low-key lighting, teal and amber color grade, 35mm photo, shallow depth of field, realistic, highly detailed

characters.emma: a 32-year-old woman with shoulder-length auburn hair, pale skin, green eyes, wearing a grey knit cardigan
characters.mark: a tall 42-year-old man with a short dark beard, short dark hair, sharp jaw, wearing a black wool coat

outline: EP1 The Text: at 3:07 a.m. Emma gets a text from her husband Daniel, dead one year: 'Don't trust Mark.' The doorbell rings: it is Mark, holding a key she never gave him.
EP2 The Guest: Mark says he was 'worried'. He keeps asking about Daniel's laptop. A new text: 'Check the garage.' In the garage sits a car she has never seen, keys in the ignition.
EP3 The Car: the car belongs to Claire Hale, a woman missing for a year. The GPS shows one last trip: a cabin by Black Lake. Mark is standing in the garage doorway.
EP4 The Cabin: Emma drives to the lake. Inside: Daniel's jacket and a cup of coffee, still warm. Someone is living here.
EP5 The Woman: Claire is alive and hiding. Her first words: 'Daniel didn't die. He ran.'
EP6 The Lie: Daniel's life insurance, Mark's debts, a deal gone wrong. A text: 'They're coming. Run.'
EP7 The Woods: headlights at the cabin. A night chase through the forest. Emma falls into a freshly dug grave.
EP8 The Grave: the grave is empty and waiting. The texts, she learns, were sent from inside her own house.
EP9 The Attic: Daniel's old phone hidden in the attic, sending timed messages. Behind her, someone breathes.
EP10 The Truth: Daniel is alive, Mark is arrested. Then one last text arrives, from a number no one knows: 'It's not over.'
